concept.vi: Động từ nhiều từ kết hợp động từ chính với tiểu từ và/hoặc giới từ; toàn bộ cụm quyết định nghĩa, vị trí tân ngữ và kiểu bổ ngữ.

whenToUse: Recognize a multiword verb as one lexical unit and preserve the particles/prepositions required by that unit.

positive: We need to come up with a more flexible backup plan.
The investigation brought about several changes in procedure.
I can't put up with that level of noise for long.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled B2 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: High-value make/do/take/have collocations
records.objective: Choose natural light-verb collocations rather than literal alternatives.

concept.en: Light verbs such as make, do, take and have combine with particular nouns in conventional collocations that are not reliably predictable from literal meaning.
concept.vi: Các động từ nhẹ như make, do, take và have kết hợp với những danh từ nhất định theo collocation quy ước, không thể luôn đoán đúng từ nghĩa đen.

whenToUse: Choose the conventional light verb that native usage strongly associates with the noun.

positive: The board made a decision after reviewing the evidence.
We need to take responsibility for the delay.
The new process has had a significant impact on response times.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled B2 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Whereas, while, nevertheless and despite
records.objective: Express contrast/concession with appropriate syntax and register.

concept.en: Concession and contrast can be expressed with conjunctions, prepositions and discourse adverbs, but each requires a different syntactic frame.
concept.vi: Quan hệ nhượng bộ và tương phản có thể được diễn đạt bằng liên từ, giới từ và trạng từ diễn ngôn, nhưng mỗi loại cần một khung cú pháp khác nhau.

whenToUse: Choose a connector that matches both the intended contrast and the grammatical form that follows it.

positive: Although the plan is expensive, it could save money in the long term.
Despite the initial resistance, the new system was adopted successfully.
The northern region grew rapidly, whereas demand in the south remained stable.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled B2 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Due to, owing to, consequently and as a result
records.objective: Express cause/effect in neutral and formal registers.

concept.en: Formal cause-and-effect language distinguishes prepositional cause markers such as due to/owing to from clause-linking result markers such as consequently and as a result.
concept.vi: Ngôn ngữ nguyên nhân-kết quả trang trọng phân biệt cụm giới từ chỉ nguyên nhân như due to/owing to với từ nối kết quả như consequently và as a result.

whenToUse: Express causal relationships with syntax and register appropriate to reports, explanations and formal argument.

positive: The flight was cancelled owing to severe weather.
The server failed unexpectedly; consequently, several services were unavailable.
Production costs rose, and as a result the company increased its prices.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled B2 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: In order to, so as to and so that
records.objective: Express purpose while controlling subject and clause structure.

concept.en: Purpose can be expressed with infinitive phrases when the understood subject is controlled, or with so that + clause when an explicit subject or modal is needed.
concept.vi: Mục đích có thể được diễn đạt bằng cụm infinitive khi chủ ngữ ngầm được kiểm soát, hoặc bằng so that + mệnh đề khi cần chủ ngữ hay modal rõ ràng.

formulae: in order to/so as to + base verb
whenToUse: Choose a purpose structure according to whether the purpose shares the main-clause subject and whether an explicit result subject is needed.

positive: We changed the schedule in order to give the team more time.
She spoke quietly so that the children wouldn't wake up.
The instructions were simplified so as to reduce confusion.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled B2 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: This/that/such as discourse reference
records.objective: Refer back to propositions and situations coherently.

concept.en: This, that and such can refer back not only to nouns but also to whole propositions, events or situations in the preceding discourse.
concept.vi: This, that và such có thể quy chiếu không chỉ về danh từ mà còn về cả mệnh đề, sự kiện hoặc tình huống đã nêu trước đó.

whenToUse: Create coherent links across sentences by packaging an earlier proposition or situation as a new discourse referent.

positive: The supplier missed two deadlines. This has delayed the entire project.
The committee rejected the proposal, and that surprised several observers.
The system requires daily manual checks. Such a process is difficult to scale.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled B2 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Substitution and ellipsis with do/so/neither/nor
records.objective: Avoid repetition while preserving grammatical meaning.

concept.en: Substitution and ellipsis use forms such as do, so, neither and nor to avoid repeating material that is recoverable from context.
concept.vi: Phép thế và lược bỏ dùng các dạng như do, so, neither và nor để tránh lặp lại phần nội dung có thể suy ra từ ngữ cảnh.

whenToUse: Avoid unnecessary repetition while preserving tense, polarity and agreement through the appropriate substitute or auxiliary.

positive: I prefer the earlier design, and the client does too.
She said the deadline was flexible, but I don't think so.
We haven't received the data, and neither has the research team.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled B2 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Formal vs informal requests and hedging
records.objective: Adjust modal, question and softening choices to social context.

concept.en: Request forms vary in directness and social distance; modals, past forms and hedging can soften a request without changing its practical goal.
concept.vi: Cách yêu cầu thay đổi theo mức độ trực tiếp và khoảng cách xã hội; modal, dạng quá khứ và từ giảm nhẹ giúp làm mềm yêu cầu mà không đổi mục đích thực tế.

formulae: I was wondering if you could ...
whenToUse: Adjust request wording to the relationship, medium and degree of imposition, especially in professional communication.

positive: Could you possibly send me the revised figures by noon?
I was wondering if you could clarify the final requirement.
Can you send me the link?

provenance.note: Project-original controlled B2 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Spoken ellipsis, response forms and conversational tags
records.objective: Use natural omissions and short follow-up structures in conversation.

concept.en: Informal conversation often omits recoverable subjects or auxiliaries and uses short response forms and tags to maintain interaction.
concept.vi: Hội thoại thân mật thường lược chủ ngữ hoặc trợ động từ có thể suy ra và dùng câu đáp ngắn hay question tag để duy trì tương tác.

whenToUse: Recognize and produce natural spoken reductions while keeping the intended tense, polarity and tag auxiliary clear.

positive: Coming with us after work?
Sounds good, doesn't it?
Need any help with those boxes?

provenance.note: Project-original controlled B2 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Adverbial position and information flow
records.objective: Place manner/place/time and sentence adverbials for clarity and emphasis.

concept.en: Adverbial position reflects both grammar and information flow; manner, place, time and sentence adverbials have preferred zones and can shift for emphasis.
concept.vi: Vị trí trạng ngữ phản ánh cả ngữ pháp lẫn dòng thông tin; cách thức, nơi chốn, thời gian và trạng ngữ toàn câu có các vị trí ưu tiên và có thể dịch chuyển để nhấn mạnh.

whenToUse: Arrange multiple adverbials so the sentence remains natural, unambiguous and appropriately focused.

positive: She carefully reviewed the contract at home last night.
Fortunately, the team completed the migration ahead of schedule.
We met at the main office early on Monday morning.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled B2 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Preposition choice and meaning contrasts
records.objective: Distinguish near-synonymous prepositions in time, place, cause and method contexts.

concept.en: Near-synonymous prepositions encode different relations of point, area, agent, means, cause and method, so literal translation often selects the wrong one.
concept.vi: Các giới từ gần nghĩa mã hóa những quan hệ khác nhau như điểm, vùng, tác nhân, phương tiện, nguyên nhân và cách thức; dịch sát từng từ thường dẫn đến chọn sai.

whenToUse: Choose prepositions from the semantic relation and collocation rather than from a one-to-one translation equivalent.

positive: We arrived at the station just before noon.
The report was written by an independent consultant for the board.
He solved the problem with a temporary workaround rather than by replacing the server.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled B2 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Conditional inversion with had/were/should
records.objective: Form formal conditionals without if.

concept.en: Formal conditionals can omit if by inverting had, were, or should before the subject.
concept.vi: Trong câu điều kiện trang trọng, có thể bỏ if và đảo had, were hoặc should lên trước chủ ngữ.

whenToUse: Use inversion in formal hypotheses, contingency clauses, and polished written argument.

positive: Had the auditors raised the issue earlier, the board could have responded before publication.
Were the subsidy to end next year, several regional services would become unviable.
Should you require further documentation, please contact the compliance office.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Fronting and topicalization
records.objective: Move constituents to the front to establish topic or contrast without losing clarity.

concept.en: Fronting moves a constituent to clause-initial position to establish topic, contrast, or a discourse frame.
concept.vi: Fronting đưa một thành phần lên đầu câu để xác lập chủ đề, tạo đối lập hoặc khung diễn ngôn.

whenToUse: Use fronting when the moved material is already salient or needs deliberate contrast.

positive: This distinction, many policy makers still fail to appreciate.
More difficult to justify is the assumption that demand will remain constant.
On the practical implications, the report has surprisingly little to say.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: It-clefts for focused emphasis
records.objective: Use It was X that/who... to focus a constituent.

concept.en: It-clefts isolate one constituent as the corrective or contrastive focus of a proposition.
concept.vi: Câu chẻ it-cleft tách một thành phần làm tiêu điểm sửa sai hoặc đối lập của mệnh đề.

formulae: It + be + focused element + that/who + clause
whenToUse: Use an it-cleft to identify precisely who, what, when, or where carries the main contrast.

positive: It was the procurement process that the inquiry criticized, not the final contract.
It is senior management who must decide whether the residual risk is acceptable.
It was after the second outage that the team changed its escalation procedure.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Wh-clefts and reversed clefts
records.objective: Use What...is... and related patterns to organize information and emphasis.

concept.en: Wh-clefts package a proposition into a wh-clause and place the focused information in a complement.
concept.vi: Wh-cleft đóng gói thông tin nền trong mệnh đề wh- và đặt thông tin trọng tâm ở bổ ngữ.

whenToUse: Use wh-clefts to organize dense information and make the new or evaluative element prominent.

positive: What the committee needs is a timetable that distinguishes urgent work from desirable work.
A clearer account of the evidence is what the reviewers asked for.
What surprised the analysts most was how quickly confidence returned.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Perfect participle clauses
records.objective: Use having + past participle for earlier non-finite events.

concept.en: Perfect participle clauses mark a non-finite event as completed before the event in the main clause.
concept.vi: Mệnh đề phân từ hoàn thành đánh dấu một sự việc không chia đã hoàn tất trước sự việc ở mệnh đề chính.

formulae: Having been + past participle, main clause
whenToUse: Use perfect participles when anteriority matters and the understood subject is shared with the main clause.

positive: Having reviewed the raw data, the panel requested a second statistical analysis.
Having been warned about the capacity limit, the organizers reduced registration.
Having completed the pilot successfully, the laboratory moved to a larger trial.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Participle clauses and subject control
records.objective: Avoid dangling or ambiguous participle clauses.

concept.en: A participle clause normally shares its understood subject with the subject of the main clause; mismatches create dangling modifiers.
concept.vi: Mệnh đề phân từ thường có chủ ngữ ngầm trùng với chủ ngữ mệnh đề chính; lệch chủ ngữ tạo dangling modifier.

whenToUse: Check subject control whenever reducing a finite clause to an -ing or -ed participle clause.

positive: Working from incomplete records, the investigators treated the early estimates cautiously.
Designed for low-bandwidth environments, the application remains usable during network congestion.
Not wishing to delay the vote, the chair shortened the final discussion.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Complex reporting passives
records.objective: Use passive reporting with perfect/continuous infinitives and appropriate evidential distance.

concept.en: Reporting passives can combine with perfect or continuous infinitives to locate the reported situation in time and distance the writer from the claim.
concept.vi: Bị động tường thuật có thể đi với nguyên mẫu hoàn thành hoặc tiếp diễn để định vị thời gian và tạo khoảng cách với thông tin được thuật lại.

formulae: subject + be + reported/believed + to have + past participle
whenToUse: Use complex reporting passives in formal reporting when evidence is attributed rather than asserted directly.

positive: The contractor is believed to have underestimated the maintenance cost by several million euros.
The species is thought to be adapting more rapidly than earlier models predicted.
Several files are reported to have been deleted before the inspection began.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Mandative subjunctive
records.objective: Use base-form subjunctives after recommendations, demands and necessity expressions.

concept.en: The mandative subjunctive uses the base form after verbs and nouns expressing recommendation, demand, or necessity.
concept.vi: Mandative subjunctive dùng dạng nguyên mẫu không to sau các từ diễn đạt khuyến nghị, yêu cầu hoặc sự cần thiết.

whenToUse: Use the base-form subjunctive especially in formal AmE and international institutional English.

positive: The ethics committee recommended that the protocol be revised before recruitment resumed.
The contract requires that each subcontractor maintain separate audit records.
Her proposal was that the decision remain confidential until Monday.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Mandative should
records.objective: Use should in formal recommendation/necessity clauses where natural.

concept.en: Mandative should is a formal alternative in recommendation and necessity clauses, particularly in British English.
concept.vi: Mandative should là lựa chọn trang trọng trong mệnh đề khuyến nghị và sự cần thiết, đặc biệt phổ biến trong Anh-Anh.

formulae: recommend/essential/important that + subject + should + base verb
whenToUse: Use mandative should where the register or regional norm favors it over the bare subjunctive.

positive: The panel recommended that an independent observer should attend every hearing.
It is essential that the revised figures should reach investors before the announcement.
The directors insisted that the matter should be reconsidered at the next meeting.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Modal remoteness and tentative meaning
records.objective: Use past/modal forms to soften stance, proposals and interpersonal claims.

concept.en: Past and modal forms can signal social or epistemic distance rather than literal past time.
concept.vi: Dạng quá khứ và modal có thể biểu thị khoảng cách xã hội hoặc mức độ dè dặt, không nhất thiết chỉ thời gian quá khứ.

whenToUse: Use modal remoteness to soften proposals, requests, and potentially face-threatening claims.

positive: I wondered whether we might postpone the decision until the legal opinion arrives.
It might be wiser to separate the two funding questions.
I was hoping you could review the revised appendix before Thursday.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Epistemic hedging
records.objective: Calibrate certainty with seem, appear, tend to, may, arguably and related patterns.

concept.en: Epistemic hedges calibrate the writer's commitment to a proposition instead of presenting uncertain evidence as fact.
concept.vi: Hedge nhận thức điều chỉnh mức độ cam kết của người viết với một mệnh đề thay vì trình bày bằng chứng chưa chắc chắn như sự thật.

whenToUse: Use hedging when evidence is limited, probabilistic, contested, or based on interpretation.

positive: The discrepancy appears to result from a change in the sampling procedure.
The policy may have reduced short-term demand without affecting long-term behavior.
Arguably, the strongest evidence comes from the longitudinal cohort.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Stance adverbials and writer positioning
records.objective: Signal confidence, evaluation and viewpoint in formal discourse.

concept.en: Stance adverbials position the writer toward the certainty, value, or interpretation of an entire proposition.
concept.vi: Trạng ngữ lập trường đặt người viết vào một vị thế về độ chắc chắn, giá trị hoặc cách diễn giải của toàn mệnh đề.

formulae: clause + stance adverbial in medial position
whenToUse: Choose stance markers that make evaluation explicit without overstating the evidence.

positive: Crucially, the comparison controls for differences in baseline risk.
Admittedly, the proposed timetable leaves little room for unexpected delays.
From a regulatory perspective, the distinction is difficult to defend.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Advanced concession: even if/even though/much as
records.objective: Choose concessive structures based on fact vs hypothesis and register.

concept.en: Advanced concessive clauses distinguish factual concession from hypothetical concession and can encode formal rhetorical contrast.
concept.vi: Cấu trúc nhượng bộ nâng cao phân biệt nhượng bộ sự thật với giả định và có thể tạo đối lập tu từ trang trọng.

whenToUse: Select the concessive marker according to whether the obstacle is known to be true, hypothetical, or rhetorically acknowledged.

positive: Even though the preliminary result is encouraging, the sample remains too small for a firm conclusion.
Even if the appeal succeeds, the implementation timetable will still need revision.
Much as I understand the concern, I cannot support the proposed exemption.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: No matter and wh-ever concession
records.objective: Express unrestricted conditions such as no matter how/whatever happens.

concept.en: Free-choice concessives express that every value or outcome within a set leads to the same result.
concept.vi: Nhượng bộ free-choice diễn đạt rằng dù lựa chọn hay kết quả nào trong một tập xảy ra thì kết quả chính vẫn không đổi.

whenToUse: Use free-choice concession to neutralize variation in person, option, degree, or circumstance.

positive: Whatever the final estimate turns out to be, the reserve will cover the statutory minimum.
No matter how carefully the model is calibrated, some uncertainty will remain.
Whichever route the commission chooses, local consultation will be required.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Sentential which clauses
records.objective: Use which to comment on a preceding clause or proposition.

concept.en: A non-defining which clause can refer back to an entire preceding proposition and add a comment on it.
concept.vi: Mệnh đề which không xác định có thể quy chiếu lại toàn bộ mệnh đề trước và bình luận về sự việc đó.

whenToUse: Use sentential which to add an evaluative consequence or comment without pretending which modifies only one noun.

positive: The regulator postponed the hearing again, which frustrated several local groups.
The data were released ahead of schedule, which allowed independent teams to replicate the analysis.
The chair rejected both amendments, which was not what either side had expected.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Advanced non-finite relative reduction
records.objective: Reduce relative clauses with participles/infinitives while preserving meaning.

concept.en: Relative clauses can be reduced to participle or infinitive clauses when the omitted subject and time/voice relation remain recoverable.
concept.vi: Mệnh đề quan hệ có thể rút gọn thành phân từ hoặc nguyên mẫu khi chủ ngữ bị lược và quan hệ thời/voice vẫn rõ.

whenToUse: Reduce relatives only when the result preserves the original voice and intended reference.

positive: Researchers working on the replication project will meet on Friday.
Applications received after the deadline will be considered only if places remain.
The next witness to appear before the committee is the former finance director.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Appositive that-clauses
records.objective: Use clauses after nouns such as fact, idea, claim and possibility.

concept.en: Appositive that-clauses specify the content of abstract nouns such as fact, claim, possibility, and assumption.
concept.vi: Mệnh đề that đồng vị nêu nội dung của các danh từ trừu tượng như fact, claim, possibility và assumption.

whenToUse: Use an appositive clause when the following clause states the content of the noun rather than modifying a participant.

positive: The assumption that prices would stabilize by June proved unrealistic.
We cannot ignore the possibility that the two failures share a common cause.
The claim that the measure is cost-neutral depends on several disputed forecasts.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Noun complement patterns
records.objective: Choose that/of -ing/to-infinitive/preposition complements after abstract nouns.

concept.en: Abstract nouns license different complement patterns, including that-clauses, of -ing, to-infinitives, and prepositional complements.
concept.vi: Danh từ trừu tượng chọn các mẫu bổ ngữ khác nhau như that-clause, of -ing, to-infinitive và cụm giới từ.

whenToUse: Learn the complement pattern with the noun rather than translating a preposition mechanically.

positive: There is little prospect of the dispute being resolved before winter.
The decision to postpone the launch was taken after the security review.
Their insistence that every exception be documented slowed the rollout.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Prepositions + wh-clauses
records.objective: Use structures such as about what, on whether and by how naturally.

concept.en: A preposition can take an embedded wh-clause or whether-clause as its complement in formal and neutral English.
concept.vi: Giới từ có thể nhận mệnh đề wh- hoặc whether làm bổ ngữ trong văn phong trung tính và trang trọng.

whenToUse: Use preposition + embedded question to package complex unknown information as a noun-like complement.

positive: The investigation focused on whether the disclosure rules had been followed consistently.
There is disagreement about what the revised standard actually requires.
The outcome will depend on how the tribunal interprets the exemption.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Future Perfect Continuous
records.objective: Emphasize duration of activity up to a future point.

concept.en: The Future Perfect Continuous measures the duration of an activity up to a specified future reference point.
concept.vi: Future Perfect Continuous nhấn mạnh khoảng thời gian một hoạt động kéo dài cho đến một mốc tương lai.

whenToUse: Use it when duration up to a future point matters more than simple completion.

positive: By next September, the research team will have been monitoring the wetland for a full decade.
At midnight, engineers will have been testing the failover system for twelve hours.
By the time the review ends, she will have been leading the unit for nearly five years.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Be to for official plans and instructions
records.objective: Use be to for formal schedules, requirements and planned events.

concept.en: Be to expresses officially arranged events, formal instructions, and requirements in institutional registers.
concept.vi: Be to diễn đạt sự kiện được sắp xếp chính thức, chỉ thị và yêu cầu trong văn phong thể chế.

whenToUse: Use be to where the future event is fixed by authority, schedule, or formal arrangement.

positive: The minister is to address the assembly after the afternoon vote.
All contractors are to submit revised insurance certificates by Friday.
The two delegations are to meet in Geneva early next month.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Be due/about/bound/likely to
records.objective: Express imminence, schedule and probability with nuanced future periphrases.

concept.en: Periphrastic future expressions distinguish imminence, schedule, expectation, and strong probability.
concept.vi: Các cấu trúc tương lai ngoại vi phân biệt tính sắp xảy ra, lịch định sẵn, kỳ vọng và xác suất cao.

whenToUse: Choose the expression according to temporal imminence, scheduling, or strength of prediction.

positive: The central bank is due to publish its quarterly forecast on Thursday.
The negotiations are about to enter their most difficult phase.
Without additional capacity, the service is bound to face longer queues.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Modal perfect continuous
records.objective: Reason about past ongoing activity with must/might/could have been + -ing.

concept.en: Modal perfect continuous forms allow deduction or speculation about an activity that was ongoing in the past.
concept.vi: Modal perfect continuous cho phép suy luận hoặc phỏng đoán về một hoạt động đã đang diễn ra trong quá khứ.

whenToUse: Use the form when both past time and ongoing duration/activity are relevant to the inference.

positive: The server must have been processing a large backup when the response time suddenly increased.
They may have been negotiating privately before the public talks began.
The sensor could have been transmitting faulty readings for several hours.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Counterfactual modal nuance
records.objective: Distinguish would/could/might have in unreal past results.

concept.en: Would have, could have, and might have encode different unreal-past meanings: expected result, unrealized ability/option, and uncertain possibility.
concept.vi: Would have, could have và might have mang sắc thái quá khứ phản thực khác nhau: kết quả kỳ vọng, khả năng/lựa chọn không thực hiện và khả năng chưa chắc.

whenToUse: Choose the result modal according to certainty, ability, permission, or possibility in the imagined past.

positive: With a larger sample, the study might have detected a smaller effect.
A second pump could have prevented the basement from flooding.
Had the warning arrived in time, we would have suspended the release.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Unreal past in preferences and criticism
records.objective: Use would rather/sooner, would prefer and It's time with correct subject/time reference.

concept.en: Unreal-past forms after would rather, would sooner, and It's time express present preferences, criticism, or overdue action.
concept.vi: Dạng quá khứ phi thực sau would rather, would sooner và It's time diễn đạt sở thích hiện tại, lời phê bình hoặc việc đã đến lúc phải làm.

whenToUse: Use unreal past when the subject of the preferred or overdue action is different from the speaker or the action is not yet real.

positive: I'd rather the department published the methodology before announcing the headline figure.
It's time the agency explained how the exception is being applied.
She would sooner the matter remained confidential until the audit finished.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Supposing, provided, but for and otherwise
records.objective: Express formal, hypothetical and exception conditions compactly.

concept.en: Formal condition markers such as provided, supposing, but for, and otherwise compress different conditional relations.
concept.vi: Các dấu hiệu điều kiện trang trọng như provided, supposing, but for và otherwise nén những quan hệ điều kiện khác nhau.

whenToUse: Use each marker for its specific meaning: sufficient condition, hypothesis, exception, or avoided consequence.

positive: Provided that the safeguards remain in place, the trial can continue.
But for a last-minute appeal, the demolition would already have begun.
Submit the declaration by Friday; otherwise, the application will lapse.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Mixed conditionals: time and causality nuance
records.objective: Build cross-time counterfactuals only when the causal relationship is coherent.

concept.en: Mixed conditionals connect counterfactual cause and result across different time frames only when the causal relation is coherent.
concept.vi: Mixed conditional nối nguyên nhân và kết quả phản thực ở các mốc thời gian khác nhau khi quan hệ nhân quả thực sự hợp lý.

formulae: if + past perfect, would + base verb
if + past simple, would have + past participle
whenToUse: Choose tense combinations from the cause-result timeline rather than memorizing a fixed label.

positive: If the company had invested in training earlier, it would have a stronger internal security team now.
If she were less risk-averse, she would have accepted the partnership last year.
If we had not changed the architecture, the platform would still be struggling under peak load.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Ellipsis after auxiliaries
records.objective: Omit repeated verb phrases after auxiliaries while preserving tense/modal meaning.

concept.en: After an auxiliary or modal, a repeated verb phrase can be omitted when its content is recoverable from context.
concept.vi: Sau trợ động từ hoặc modal, có thể lược cụm động từ lặp lại khi nội dung đã suy ra được từ ngữ cảnh.

formulae: subject + auxiliary/modal (+ not), with VP omitted
whenToUse: Use auxiliary ellipsis to avoid repetition while preserving tense, polarity, and modality.

positive: The first model predicted a decline, but the revised model didn't.
Some departments may extend the deadline, while others may not.
I haven't reviewed the annex yet, but the legal team has.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: One/ones, that/those, former/latter and do so
records.objective: Choose substitution devices by noun type, register and discourse relation.

concept.en: Substitution devices replace repeated nouns or propositions while preserving number, type, and discourse relation.
concept.vi: Các phương tiện thay thế thay cho danh từ hoặc mệnh đề đã nêu, đồng thời phải giữ đúng số, loại và quan hệ diễn ngôn.

whenToUse: Choose substitution according to whether the antecedent is a count noun, a noun phrase, or a verb phrase and according to register.

positive: The revised estimate is more conservative than the one published in March.
Urban rents rose faster than those in smaller towns.
The regulator asked the company to disclose the method, and it agreed to do so.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Articles and shared situational knowledge
records.objective: Use the when identifiability comes from shared context rather than prior mention.

concept.en: Definite reference can arise from a shared physical or social situation even when the noun has not been mentioned earlier.
concept.vi: Tham chiếu xác định có thể hình thành từ bối cảnh vật lý/xã hội chung dù danh từ chưa được nhắc trước đó.

formulae: the + uniquely identifiable noun in shared context
whenToUse: Use the when speaker and listener can identify the referent from the immediate situation or shared institutional knowledge.

positive: Could you close the window before the presentation starts?
The chair will circulate the agenda after lunch.
I left the access card at reception because the security desk was already closed.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Institutional/metonymic article shifts
records.objective: Distinguish activity, institution, building and service meanings through article choice.

concept.en: Article choice can distinguish participation in an institution's normal activity from reference to its building, organization, or service.
concept.vi: Mạo từ có thể phân biệt việc tham gia hoạt động thông thường của một thể chế với việc nói về tòa nhà, tổ chức hoặc dịch vụ.

whenToUse: Use article shifts to signal whether the institution is understood functionally or as a concrete identifiable entity.

positive: The journalist went to the prison to interview the governor, while two suspects were still in prison awaiting trial.
Children usually start school at five, but their parents visited the school yesterday.
After surgery he remained in hospital for three nights before returning to the hospital for a follow-up appointment.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Partitives and proportions
records.objective: Use a proportion/share/majority/minority/percentage of with correct agreement and countability.

concept.en: Partitives and proportion expressions combine quantity heads with of-phrases, and agreement often follows the noun inside the of-phrase.
concept.vi: Cấu trúc partitive và tỷ lệ kết hợp danh từ chỉ lượng với of-phrase; hòa hợp động từ thường theo danh từ trong of-phrase.

whenToUse: Match agreement and countability to the quantified noun and the intended reading.

positive: A majority of the respondents support the revised proposal.
Nearly two thirds of the budget is allocated to long-term infrastructure.
Only a small proportion of the archived files were digitally searchable.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Agreement with complex subjects
records.objective: Handle intervening phrases, either/or, neither/nor and quantified noun phrases.

concept.en: Agreement with complex subjects depends on the grammatical head and on special coordination patterns, not simply the nearest noun.
concept.vi: Hòa hợp với chủ ngữ phức phụ thuộc vào head ngữ pháp và các mẫu phối hợp đặc biệt, không chỉ danh từ gần động từ nhất.

formulae: head noun + intervening phrase + agreeing verb
either X or Y / neither X nor Y + proximity-sensitive agreement
whenToUse: Identify the subject head before choosing verb number, then handle correlative coordination according to accepted register norms.

positive: The quality of the supporting documents has improved substantially.
Neither the regional offices nor the central unit has confirmed the figure.
A series of unexpected delays has pushed the launch into the next quarter.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Notional and proximity agreement
records.objective: Choose singular/plural agreement with collective and coordinated meanings by dialect/register.

concept.en: Notional agreement lets meaning, collectivity, or proximity influence number where grammar permits more than one convention.
concept.vi: Notional agreement cho phép ý nghĩa, tính tập thể hoặc khoảng cách ảnh hưởng đến số của động từ khi ngữ pháp cho phép nhiều quy ước.

formulae: collective noun + singular/plural verb by meaning and dialect
whenToUse: Choose agreement consistently with dialect, register, and whether a group is conceptualized as one unit or as members.

positive: The committee has reached its decision after three hours of debate.
The committee are divided over how the new rule should be interpreted.
Ten kilometres is too far to walk with this equipment.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Advanced adjective complementation
records.objective: Choose adjective + that-clause/to-infinitive/preposition patterns and understood subjects.

concept.en: Adjectives select different complement types and may assign the understood subject of an infinitive in different ways.
concept.vi: Tính từ chọn các loại bổ ngữ khác nhau và có thể gán chủ ngữ ngầm của infinitive theo những cách khác nhau.

whenToUse: Learn adjective-complement pairings and check who is understood to perform an infinitive action.

positive: The board is reluctant to disclose the preliminary estimate before verification.
We are confident that the revised procedure will withstand external scrutiny.
She is concerned about relying on a single supplier for a critical component.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Advanced verb complementation
records.objective: Control complex patterns after perception, causative, reporting and attitude verbs.

concept.en: Advanced verb complementation distinguishes bare infinitives, to-infinitives, -ing clauses, and object-plus-complement patterns after particular verbs.
concept.vi: Verb complementation nâng cao phân biệt bare infinitive, to-infinitive, -ing và mẫu object + complement sau từng động từ.

whenToUse: Treat complement selection as part of the lexical grammar of the controlling verb.

positive: The new evidence led the investigators to reconsider their original timeline.
We observed the pressure fall steadily as the valve opened.
The consultant advised the board to postpone the tender until the specifications were clearer.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Resultative constructions
records.objective: Use patterns such as wipe it clean/paint it red where English licenses result states.

concept.en: Resultative constructions pair an action with a complement that names the state produced by that action.
concept.vi: Resultative construction ghép một hành động với bổ ngữ chỉ trạng thái kết quả do hành động tạo ra.

whenToUse: Use resultatives only with combinations that English conventionally licenses; not every verb and adjective can combine productively.

positive: The technicians wiped the sensor housing clean before reassembly.
The heat warped the plastic panel out of shape.
They hammered the damaged bracket flat enough to fit the replacement frame.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Causative and ergative alternation
records.objective: Distinguish verbs used transitively for causing change vs intransitively for change.

concept.en: Some change-of-state verbs alternate between a transitive causative use and an intransitive ergative use.
concept.vi: Một số động từ chỉ thay đổi trạng thái luân phiên giữa cách dùng ngoại động gây biến đổi và nội động biểu thị tự thay đổi.

whenToUse: Use the alternation when English allows the changed entity to appear either as object of a cause or as subject of the change.

positive: The sudden temperature drop cracked the outer seal.
The outer seal cracked during the overnight freeze.
Higher interest rates have narrowed the gap, but the gap may widen again next year.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Formal discourse markers
records.objective: Organize arguments with moreover, nonetheless, conversely, hence and related markers.

concept.en: Formal discourse markers signal addition, concession, contrast, consequence, and inference between stretches of argument.
concept.vi: Dấu nối diễn ngôn trang trọng biểu thị bổ sung, nhượng bộ, đối lập, hệ quả và suy luận giữa các phần lập luận.

whenToUse: Choose a connector whose logical relation matches the argument and whose register fits formal prose.

positive: The intervention reduced waiting times; moreover, it improved continuity of care.
The initial forecast was optimistic. Nonetheless, the reserve proved sufficient.
The sample was not representative; hence, the estimate should not be generalized nationally.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Cohesion and reference chains
records.objective: Maintain clear pronoun, demonstrative and lexical reference across paragraphs.

concept.en: Cohesive reference chains keep entities identifiable across sentences by controlling pronouns, demonstratives, repetition, and lexical reformulation.
concept.vi: Chuỗi quy chiếu tạo liên kết giúp người đọc theo dõi thực thể qua nhiều câu bằng đại từ, từ chỉ định, lặp có kiểm soát và thay thế từ vựng.

formulae: clear noun phrase → pronoun/demonstrative → lexical restatement
whenToUse: Maintain an unambiguous antecedent whenever several possible referents are active in a paragraph.

positive: The commission published two reports. The second document focuses on enforcement, and it recommends a new appeals process.
A sensor and a controller failed simultaneously. This combination made the original diagnosis difficult.
The proposal was revised twice. Those changes resolved the pricing issue but not the governance dispute.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Given/new information and clause ordering
records.objective: Order information so known material leads naturally to new/focal material.

concept.en: English information structure often places accessible or given material early and reserves new, heavy, or focal material for later positions.
concept.vi: Cấu trúc thông tin tiếng Anh thường đặt thông tin đã biết ở đầu và để thông tin mới, nặng hoặc trọng tâm về sau.

formulae: light before heavy where grammar allows
whenToUse: Order clauses and noun phrases so the reader can anchor each new point in information already active.

positive: The original model assumed constant demand. That assumption is what the new evidence most directly challenges.
Several risks were identified during testing. The most serious was an undocumented dependency in the payment service.
A revised timetable was circulated yesterday. At its center is a six-week external review.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Grammatical parallelism
records.objective: Keep coordinated lists, comparisons and paired structures grammatically parallel.

concept.en: Parallelism keeps coordinated and compared elements in matching grammatical forms, making complex prose easier to process.
concept.vi: Parallelism giữ các thành phần phối hợp hoặc so sánh ở dạng ngữ pháp tương ứng, giúp văn bản phức dễ đọc hơn.

formulae: X, Y, and Z in matching forms
not only X but also Y
whenToUse: Use parallel forms in lists, paired structures, headings, and formal comparisons.

positive: The review aims to reduce duplication, improve accountability, and clarify decision rights.
The reform affected not only how funds were allocated but also how outcomes were reported.
The committee asked whether the rule was necessary, whether it was proportionate, and whether it was enforceable.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Impersonal constructions in formal writing
records.objective: Use passive, anticipatory it and impersonal reporting without obscuring responsibility.

concept.en: Formal prose can background the actor with passives, anticipatory it, and impersonal reporting, but these choices should not conceal responsibility unnecessarily.
concept.vi: Văn phong trang trọng có thể làm mờ tác nhân bằng bị động, anticipatory it và reporting impersonal, nhưng không nên che trách nhiệm một cách không cần thiết.

whenToUse: Use impersonal forms for process/evidence focus while naming the actor when accountability matters.

positive: It is widely accepted that the current measure underestimates informal work.
Further testing is required before the device can be approved for clinical use.
It appears that two different definitions were used in the original survey.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Spoken headers and tails
records.objective: Recognize/use conversational topic frames such as That car, is it yours? and It's nice, that place.

concept.en: Spoken headers introduce a topic before the clause, while tails add a clarifying noun phrase after a clause or pronoun.
concept.vi: Trong hội thoại, header giới thiệu chủ đề trước mệnh đề, còn tail thêm cụm danh từ làm rõ sau mệnh đề/đại từ.

whenToUse: Use headers and tails in conversation for topic management; avoid importing them unedited into formal prose.

positive: That new procurement portal, have you managed to use it yet?
It's surprisingly intuitive, the mobile version.
Those figures from last quarter, do we still need them in the appendix?

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Vague language and approximators
records.objective: Use kind of, roughly, or so, and things like that appropriately by register.

concept.en: Vague language deliberately reduces precision through approximators and open-ended category markers when exactness is unnecessary or unavailable.
concept.vi: Vague language cố ý giảm độ chính xác bằng từ xấp xỉ và dấu hiệu danh mục mở khi không cần hoặc chưa thể nêu chính xác.

whenToUse: Use vague language appropriately in speech and informal prose, but replace it with precise wording where formal accountability requires exactness.

positive: Roughly two hundred households responded to the first survey.
The repair should take another hour or so if no further damage is found.
We discussed staffing, scheduling, procurement, and things like that.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Politeness and mitigation
records.objective: Use distancing, softeners and indirect forms to manage face-sensitive requests/disagreement.

concept.en: Mitigation softens requests, disagreement, and criticism through modal distance, tentative framing, and partial agreement.
concept.vi: Mitigation làm mềm yêu cầu, bất đồng và phê bình bằng khoảng cách modal, cách diễn đạt dè dặt và đồng thuận một phần.

whenToUse: Use mitigation when preserving the relationship matters, while keeping the requested action or disagreement clear.

positive: I was wondering whether you might be able to send the revised schedule before the meeting.
I take your point about cost, but I am not convinced the proposed saving is sustainable.
It may be worth checking the assumption with the regional team before we finalize the paper.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Boosters and downtoners
records.objective: Control emphasis with highly, strongly, rather, somewhat and related stance choices.

concept.en: Boosters strengthen commitment or degree, while downtoners deliberately reduce force; both are sensitive to collocation and register.
concept.vi: Booster tăng mức độ/cam kết, còn downtoner chủ ý giảm lực diễn đạt; cả hai phụ thuộc collocation và văn phong.

whenToUse: Calibrate emphasis rather than stacking intensifiers mechanically.

positive: The evidence strongly supports a phased implementation rather than an immediate national rollout.
The revised definition is somewhat broader than the one used in the pilot.
The findings are highly relevant to services that rely on seasonal staff.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.

records.title: Advanced preposition choice
records.objective: Resolve idiomatic and abstract preposition contrasts that cannot be predicted from literal meaning alone.

concept.en: Advanced preposition choice is often lexically fixed or meaning-sensitive and cannot be predicted reliably from literal translation.
concept.vi: Lựa chọn giới từ nâng cao thường mang tính từ vựng/collocation hoặc phụ thuộc nghĩa và không thể suy ra chắc chắn bằng dịch sát.

whenToUse: Learn the preposition with the governing word and verify whether alternative prepositions change meaning or register.

positive: The committee expressed reservations about the proposed exemption from the reporting requirement.
The new guidance is consistent with the principles set out in the earlier judgment.
There is considerable scope for improvement in how the agency communicates risk.

provenance.note: Project-original controlled C1 grammar-body content; publication is review-ledger only.
